desc.zh: 从最少删除预算出发，推导不重复的括号搜索。
desc.en: Derive duplicate-free search from the exact minimum-removal budget.

complexity: O(2^p·n) time in the worst case (p ≤ 20 parentheses); O(n) recursion space plus output

concepts.name: Removal budget
concepts.description: Walk the balance: each dip below zero forces a ) deletion, each open left at the end forces a ( deletion.

concepts.name: Balance invariant
concepts.description: A kept prefix never has negative balance; the search spends exactly the budget.

concepts.name: Duplicate collapse
concepts.description: Different deletion positions can give the same string; a set keeps one copy.
